body: {"items":[{"id":"2026-22341","title":"NCES Request for Information, Correction","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/02/2026-22341/nces-request-for-information-correction","summary":"On October 29, 2026, the U.S. Department of Education published a notice in the Federal Register announcing a Request for Information (RFI) for NCES with FR DOC# 2026- 22047 (91 FR 68118, pages 68118-68120). The Notice asked the public to submit comments electronically using regulations.gov, but the Docket No. was not properly included within the Notice. The Docket No. for this RFI is ED- 2026-IES-3235. ED is issuing this correction notice to ensure that NCES can properly receive the requested information from the field and more effectively carry out requirements laid out in 20 U.S.C. 9543.","publishedAt":"2026-11-02","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-22174","title":"Accreditation, Innovation, and Modernization: The Secretary's Recognition of Accrediting Agencies; Institutional Eligibility Under the Higher Education Act of 1965, as Amended; Student Assistance General Provisions","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/30/2026-22174/accreditation-innovation-and-modernization-the-secretarys-recognition-of-accrediting-agencies","summary":"The Department revises the existing accrediting agency recognition regulations to implement the directives set forth in Executive Order 14279, Reforming Accreditation to Strengthen Higher Education, and other Administration priorities, align the regulations more closely with statute, and reduce regulatory burden.","publishedAt":"2026-10-30","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-22047","title":"Request for Information","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/29/2026-22047/request-for-information","summary":"NCES seeks comment on the strategic redesign of its portfolio of studies, including administrative data collections and sample surveys, both cross-sectional and longitudinal.","publishedAt":"2026-10-29","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-22040","title":"List of Borrowers Who Have Defaulted on Their Health Education Assistance Loans","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/29/2026-22040/list-of-borrowers-who-have-defaulted-on-their-health-education-assistance-loans","summary":"Federal Student Aid (FSA), as required by the Public Health Service Act (the Act), is publishing this list of Health Education Assistance Loan (HEAL) borrowers who have defaulted on their loans as of August 17, 2026. This information is also made available for use by organizations authorized by the Act.","publishedAt":"2026-10-29","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21962","title":"Agency Information Collection Activities; Submission to the Office of Management and Budget for Review and Approval; Comment Request; Build America, Buy America Act (BABAA) Domestic Sourcing Requirements Waiver-United States Department of Education BABAA Waiver Request Form","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/28/2026-21962/agency-information-collection-activities-submission-to-the-office-of-management-and-budget-for","summary":"In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) of 1995, the Department is proposing a reinstatement without change of a previously approved information collection request (ICR).","publishedAt":"2026-10-28","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21827","title":"Committee and Quarterly Board Meetings","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/27/2026-21827/committee-and-quarterly-board-meetings","summary":"This notice sets forth the agenda, time, and instructions to access the National Assessment Governing Board's (hereafter referred to as the Board or Governing Board) standing committee meetings and quarterly Governing Board meeting. This notice provides information to members of the public who may be interested in attending the meetings and/or providing written comments related to the work of the Governing Board. The meetings will be held either in person and/or virtually, as noted below. Members of the public, whether participating in person or virtually, must register in advance. A registration link will be posted on the Governing Board's website, www.nagb.gov, no later than five (5) business days prior to each meeting.","publishedAt":"2026-10-27","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21804","title":"Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/26/2026-21804/privacy-act-of-1974-system-of-records","summary":"In accordance with the Privacy Act of 1974, as amended (Privacy Act), the U.S. Department of Education (Department) publishes this notice of a new system of records titled \"National Center for Education Evaluation and Regional Assistance (NCEE) Evaluation Studies\" (18-14-49) and rescindment of the following system of records notices, as the records previously covered by those notices are now covered by the NCEE Evaluation Studies system of records: DC Choice Program Evaluation (18-13-07), Evaluation of Teacher Residency Programs (18-13-24), National Longitudinal Transitions Study 2012 (18-13-27), Evaluation of the Pell Grant Experiments Under the Experimental Sites Initiative--2012 (18-13-31), Study of Enhanced College Advising in Upward Bound (18-13-36), National Evaluation of the Striving Readers Comprehensive Literacy and Comprehensive Literacy State Development Programs (18-35-45), Connecting Adults to Success: Evaluation of Career Navigator Training (18-13-46), and Impact Evaluation of Training in Multi-Tiered Systems of Support for Reading In Early Elementary School (18-13-48). The Department proposes this new system of records to cover records from the identified studies and future NCEE evaluation studies that fall within the categories of individuals, categories of records, purposes, routine uses, and other terms described in this notice, in order to promote efficiency across its research and evaluation functions.","publishedAt":"2026-10-26","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21685","title":"Clarification on Department of Justice and Department of Education Guidance Documents Regarding Federal Nondiscrimination Laws","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/23/2026-21685/clarification-on-department-of-justice-and-department-of-education-guidance-documents-regarding","summary":"The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) and U.S. Department of Education (ED) (the Departments) are issuing this document to clarify that seven guidance documents issued jointly by the Departments are not enforceable. In addition, the Departments plan to revisit these guidance documents in light of the Supreme Court's decision in Loper Bright Enters. v. Raimondo, 603 U.S. 369, 400 (2024), to assess whether they are consistent with the single best meaning of the relevant statutory text. The Departments will not rely upon these guidance documents in their enforcement of federal civil rights laws, including Titles IV and VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (Title IV and Title VI), 42 U.S.C. 2000c et seq. and 2000d et seq., the Equal Educational Opportunities Act of 1974 (EEOA), 20 U.S.C. 1701-1720, the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (ADA), 42 U.S.C. 12101 et seq., and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (Section 504), 29 U.S.C. 794.","publishedAt":"2026-10-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21678","title":"Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA®) Information To Be Verified for the 2027-2028 Award Year","url":"https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/23/2026-21678/free-application-for-federal-student-aid-fafsa-information-to-be-verified-for-the-2027-2028-award","summary":"For each award year, the Secretary publishes in the Federal Register a notice announcing the FAFSA information that an institution and an applicant may be required to verify, as well as the acceptable documentation for verifying FAFSA information. This is the notice for the 2027-2028 award year; Assistance Listing Numbers 84.007, 84.033, 84.063, and 84.268.","publishedAt":"2026-10-23","source":"Federal Register"},{"id":"2026-21667","title":"Agency Information Collection Activities;
